# Cncf Bronto Reviewer

Review Bronto using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. Bronto is an AI-native observability data platform for logs, metrics and traces. It lets teams ingest telemetry at petabyte scale with sub-second search, 12-month hot data retention by default and up to 90% lower storage costs, with all data parsed, searchable and enriched with context for both human and agentic workflows.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
